component.name: Lucerne
component.summary: Letters with free image placement and live text flow

description.p: Lucerne is a small, pleasant, ClarisWorks-style word editor for writing letters. Its defining feature is genuine free placement of images: drop a picture anywhere on the page and the text flows around it, live, staying correct through every subsequent edit.

Documents are saved as .luce — a plain ZIP package containing readable JSON, your images, and a Markdown backup trail, so your letters stay recoverable with any archive tool. Files are fully compatible with Lucerne for Mac.
